method: Individually viewed labelled full and ground source images; field-level development audit, not held-out accuracy or 3D acceptance.

entries.groundBand: A low grey stone plinth is visible; main ground wall remains brick. Do not colour the entire ground floor grey.
entries.roofline: Front cornice is broadly horizontal, with a small central raised element; complete roof mass is not established.
entries.review: Rich assessment misses the visible entrance and counts three rather than four opening levels. Ground-only assessment falsely says no entrance and misses visible low plinth. Paired red doors share an arched surround; exact doorway count needs a stated convention.

entries.groundBand: Exposed brick continues around ground openings; car obscures the lowest band.
entries.roofline: Full image is overexposed at the top; do not infer roof shape.
entries.review: Ground image shows two unambiguous side doors. Central glazed pair could be another entrance, but threshold/handles are insufficiently clear. Ground-only count3 is not independently accepted; rich assessment unnecessarily withholds entrance presence.

entries.groundBand: Full view clearly shows grey masonry base and cream/ochre upper finish, with a stepped boundary around the right window. Ground view is mostly tree-obscured.
entries.roofline: Broadly flat front parapet with changes in height across the building; no gable shape supported.
entries.review: Rich entrance presence is supported by full photo, but four opening levels undercounts five. Ground-only entrance unknown is appropriate for this heavily occluded crop. Do not treat the ground crop alone as evidence of no storefront components.

entries.groundBand: A distinct dark low plinth is exposed at left, below pale horizontally scored wall.
entries.roofline: A shallow tiled roof strip sits above front cornice; this side-facing crop does not establish a named gable.
entries.review: Both assessments claim absent entrance despite cropped/obscured right opening. Skip blocks lower half. Ground-only misses dark plinth and asserts painted brick where surface substrate is uncertain.

entries.groundBand: White upper finish continues around curved ground opening; vegetation prevents a reliable plinth assessment.
entries.roofline: Sloping ornate gable edges visible; crest extends beyond crop. Do not force complete silhouette or precise gable family.
entries.review: Ground-only says absent entrance although dense foliage obscures the opening. Unknown is required. Roofline geometry must remain partial, even if architectural style is recognizable.
